# Emotume - AI-Powered Emotional Chat Experience
> The world's first AI-powered emotional chat platform with real-time emotion analysis, song suggestions, shayari, memory mesh, and intelligent conversations.

## Overview
Emotume is a full-stack MERN application that combines real-time messaging with AI-driven emotional analysis, semantic memory search, fact-checking, persona-based tone transfer, and group decision-making features.

## Products
- **Emotume Chat** - AI-powered real-time messaging with emotion analysis
- **Memory Mesh** - Semantic search across conversations using AI embeddings
- **Intent Streams** - Auto-classified messages by purpose (task, social, question, idea, reminder)
- **TruthSync** - Decentralized fact-check indicator with community voting
- **Persona Portals** - Multiple digital selves with AI tone-transfer
- **Silent Connect** - Zero-notification messages with separate silent inbox
- **DecideFlow** - AI parliament for group decisions with auto-polls

## Core Features
- Real-time messaging with Socket.IO
- AI emotion analysis and song suggestions
- Semantic memory search with embeddings
- Message intent classification
- Fact-checking with community voting
- AI persona-based message rewriting
- End-to-end encryption support
- Group chat with decision-making
- Cloudinary media uploads
- Dark/light theme system with 6 themes
- Responsive design

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Socket.IO Client
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, Socket.IO
- **AI**: Google Gemini, OpenAI, HuggingFace (fallback chain)
- **Database**: MongoDB with Redis caching
- **Auth**: JWT with access/refresh token rotation
- **Media**: Cloudinary for uploads
- **Workers**: BullMQ for background tasks (embeddings, intent, truth)

## API
- RESTful API at `/api`
- WebSocket for real-time events
- Auth: JWT Bearer tokens
- Endpoints: auth, messages, chats, users, AI, groups, bookmarks, memory, truth, personas, decide, upload

## Pricing
- Free tier with full core features
- Premium features planned
